run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T03:22:38Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend alert reflects a short burst of frontend request errors between 03:22:38 and 03:29:38 UTC, and the evidence ties every part of that burst to failed calls to the ad service. All frontend error spans sit on one path: 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' (424.1 error spans, i.e. every span of that route in the window), 'GET /api/data' (424.1 of 1995.9) and the client span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (424.1 of 1995.9); frontend routes to cart, checkout, product-catalog and recommendation recorded zero error spans. At the same time, deployment ad was rollout-restarted: the only ad pod was killed at 03:21:30 and replaced by pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz, whose container has no readiness/startup probe, so it was reported Ready at 03:21:30 while the Java service only logged 'Ad service starting.' at 03:25:40 and only resumed serving GetAds calls at ~03:29:38 (its server-side span counter was flat at 1312 from 03:22:38 to 03:28:38). During that gap frontend attempts to reach ad failed at connection setup (15 failed tcp.connect spans, while dns.lookup had zero error spans), and the frontend's GetAds and /api/data error counters rose 383 -> 801 and then stayed flat through the last sample at 03:38:38. Both ad ReplicaSets use the same image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) and their pod templates differ only by kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-15T03:21:27Z, so this was a configuration-only manual rollout restart, not an image change. Impact was observed on frontend itself and on frontend-proxy (455.6 error 'ingress' spans, 424.1 error 'router frontend egress' spans). The exact alert expression and the 'current: 2.355555555555555' value could not be verified because no rules are returned by Prometheus, and Jaeger holds no traces after ~03:19:12, so the client-side error message text was not observable.

claims.text: Frontend error spans in the 02:22:38-03:44:25 window are concentrated on one path: span_name 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' 424.1 error spans (424.1 total), 'GET /api/data' 424.1 error of 1995.9 calls, 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 424.1 error of 1995.9 calls, generic 'GET' 424.1 error of 19298.7, and 'tcp.connect' 15.2 error of 16.2. 'GET /api/cart', 'POST /api/cart', 'POST /api/checkout', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', 'GET /api/products/{productId}', 'GET /api/recommendations' and the CartService/CheckoutService/ProductCatalog/Recommendation gRPC client spans recorded 0 error spans.

The frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' error counter was flat at 383 until 03:21:38, rose to 415 at 03:22:38 and to 801 by 03:29:38 (418 new error spans), then stayed flat at 801 through the last sample at 03:38:38; the 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' error counter shows exactly the same 383 -> 801 shape and timing.

The ad service's server-side counter for span 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' climbed steadily to 1312 at 03:22:38, stayed exactly flat at 1312 through 03:28:38, and resumed climbing at 03:29:38 (1363) - i.e. the ad service received no GetAds calls for about seven minutes, exactly the interval in which frontend GetAds calls errored.

The ad service's own GetAds spans carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET (1551.1 spans, no error status) and its getAdsByCategory (1340.2) and getRandomAds (429.8) spans are also UNSET; the only ad error span series in the window is 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' with 1.02 error spans.

Kubernetes events show a deployment rollout of ad at 03:21:27-03:21:30: 'Scaled up replica set ad-d89765fb5 from 0 to 1' (03:21:27), 'Created pod: ad-d89765fb5-whfnz' (03:21:27), 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0' (03:21:30), 'Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-gcmfq' (03:21:30) and 'Stopping container ad' on ad-554b849958-gcmfq (03:21:30).

Pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz started container ad at 03:21:29, had condition Ready=True from 03:21:30 and restartCount 0, and its container spec has readinessProbe=null, livenessProbe=null and startupProbe=null, with resources requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi and limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi.

The two ad ReplicaSets ad-554b849958 (replicas 0) and ad-d89765fb5 (replicas 1) both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with identical env, ports and resources; their pod templates differ only in the annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-15T03:21:27Z on the new template, and deployment ad is at revision 2 / generation 2.
The only log line the ad container of ad-d89765fb5-whfnz wrote between 03:15:00 and 03:35:00 is 'Ad service starting.' at 2026-11-15T03:25:40.903167388Z (no previous container instance exists).

The frontend's client-side 'tcp.connect' error counter went from 27 to 42 (+15 failed connection attempts) between 03:22:38 and 03:29:38 and then stayed flat, while its 'dns.lookup' spans showed 16.2 total calls and 0 error spans over the whole window.

frontend-proxy recorded 455.6 error spans on operation 'ingress' (of 24770.1) and 424.1 error spans on 'router frontend egress' (of 24771.0) in the window, so failed requests were visible at the proxy layer in front of frontend.

Per-service error-span increases in the window are: frontend 1711.8, frontend-proxy 879.8, recommendation 4.06, fraud-detection 2.04, ad 1.02, accounting 0 and payment 0; no error-span series was returned for cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, product-catalog, quote, shipping, kafka or load-generator.

The frontend workload itself was not changed or restarted: deployment frontend is at generation 1 / revision 1 with 1 ready replica, and pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-c8fk6 started at 02:49:00 with ready=true and restartCount 0.
Service ad currently has one endpoint address 100.96.1.122 on port 8080 (port name tcp-service) and no notReadyAddresses; this describes the state at query time only, not the incident window.

Leading cause: the ad deployment's rollout restart at 03:21:27 removed the only serving ad pod, and because the ad container defines no readiness or startup probe the replacement pod ad-d89765fb5-whfnz was declared Ready at 03:21:30 and placed in the Service endpoints while the Java ad service was still starting (first log line 'Ad service starting.' at 03:25:40, server-side GetAds spans resuming only at 03:29:38). Frontend calls to ad therefore failed at connect time (15 failed tcp.connect spans, zero ad server spans), the frontend's /api/data route failed on every span in that interval, and frontend's request error rate rose above 0, firing the alert at 03:22:38.

Contributing factor: the ad container's CPU limit of 50m plausibly stretched JVM start-up, which would explain why the container started at 03:21:29 but the process only logged 'Ad service starting.' at 03:25:40; the observed data cannot separate slow start-up from a delayed log flush.

A remaining interval is unexplained: the ad service logged 'Ad service starting.' at 03:25:40 yet its server-side GetAds counter only resumed at 03:29:38, roughly four minutes later; one candidate explanation is that the frontend's gRPC channel stayed in reconnect backoff after the failed connects, which the available data cannot confirm.

Rejected: an ad image/version regression caused the failures. Both the old ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 and the new ad-d89765fb5 use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with identical env, ports and resources; the templates differ only by the restartedAt annotation, so this was a configuration-only rollout restart, and ad's own GetAds spans carry no error status.

Rejected: DNS resolution failure for the ad host. Frontend 'dns.lookup' spans recorded 0 error spans (16.2 calls) in the window, while failures appear on 'tcp.connect' (15.2 error spans), placing the failure at connection establishment rather than name resolution.

Rejected: a defect in frontend itself as the root cause. Frontend deployment is unchanged (generation 1, revision 1), its pod has been running since 02:49:00 with 0 restarts, and its other routes (/api/cart, /api/checkout, /api/products/{productId}, /api/recommendations) recorded 0 error spans while the only failing route is the one calling ad.

Rejected as the cause of this alert: the fraud-detection container's OOMKill. Its container last terminated with reason OOMKilled and exitCode 137 at 02:54:22 and restarted at 02:54:22, i.e. before the 03:22-03:29 error burst, fraud-detection shows only 2.04 error spans in the window, and the checkout route it serves (/api/checkout, POST /api/checkout, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) recorded 0 error spans.

Add a readiness and/or startup probe (gRPC or TCP on container port 8080) to the ad container so a restarting pod is not added to the ad Service endpoints before the Java service is listening; this is the resource/label gap that allowed a Ready pod with no listener.

Raise the ad container's CPU limit (currently 50m) and/or use a RollingUpdate with more than one replica or maxUnavailable 0, so that a rollout restart does not leave the ad service with no serving endpoint while a 50m-CPU JVM starts.

gaps: No alerting rules were returned by Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules rule_name=RequestErrorRate and type=alert both returned no_data), so the alert expression and the reported 'current: 2.355555555555555' value could not be verified or reproduced.

Jaeger holds no traces after about 03:19:12 (traces_search for frontend 03:24:30-03:25:00 and tag-filtered error searches returned no traces), so the client-side error message/detail for the 03:22-03:29 burst was not observable; the connection-failure mechanism rests on span-status counters and the ad server-side gap.
Frontend pod logs returned no lines matching error filters for 03:18:00-03:32:00 (status no_data), so application log confirmation of the failing GetAds call is missing.
The change_history integration is not available, so who or what triggered the ad rollout restart at 03:21:27 (restartedAt annotation) could not be verified.
Trace-span metric series end at 03:38:38 (data_as_of), so frontend error state after that instant, and whether the RequestErrorRate alert has since cleared, are unknown.

Why the ad service did not serve GetAds until ~03:29:38 although it logged 'Ad service starting.' at 03:25:40 remains unexplained; candidate explanations (continued initialisation vs frontend gRPC reconnect backoff) could not be separated.
The ad pod has no previous container instance and only one current log line, so ad-side start-up logs beyond 'Ad service starting.' are unavailable.

Metrics rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket, http_server_request_duration_seconds_count and app_payment_transactions_total returned no series in this Prometheus, so HTTP/gRPC request-level error and latency signals could not be checked.

No error-span series was returned for cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, product-catalog, quote, shipping, kafka or load-generator, so their own error state is unknown rather than zero (only accounting and payment returned explicit zero error counts).
next_steps: Review change/audit records for who ran a rollout restart (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-15T03:21:27Z) on deployment ad in namespace otel-demo, since change history is not integrated in this run.
Add readiness/startup probes to the ad container and re-evaluate its 50m CPU limit before the next restart of the ad Deployment.
Load the alerting rule definition for RequestErrorRate into the queried Prometheus (or expose the rule source) so the exact expression and the reported value can be validated.
Retain Jaeger traces (or raise its in-memory retention) so a restart-induced outage window remains inspectable, and confirm the frontend's ad gRPC client reconnect behaviour.
